# Test Audio Vectors

These files are standard MP3 conformance test vectors imported from the `lieff/minimp3` repository.

## Source & Version
- **Repository:** https://github.com/lieff/minimp3
- **Commit:** 7b590fdcfa5a79c033e76eacc05d0c3e4c79f536
- **License:** CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain dedication)

## Files List
- `l1-fl4.mp3` (originally `l1-fl4.bit`): MPEG1 Layer 1 test vector.
- `l2-fl13.mp3` (originally `l2-fl13.bit`): MPEG1 Layer 2 test vector.
- `l3-he_32khz.mp3` (originally `l3-he_32khz.bit`): MPEG1 Layer 3, 32kHz sample rate test vector.
- `l3-hecommon.mp3` (originally `l3-hecommon.bit`): MPEG1 Layer 3 bits cases test vector.
- `l3-nonstandard-id3v2.mp3` (originally `l3-nonstandard-id3v2.bit`): MPEG1 Layer 3 with ID3v2 tag test vector.
- `l3-sin1k0db.mp3` (originally `l3-sin1k0db.bit`): MPEG1 Layer 3 1kHz sine wave test vector.
